svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Online Exams & Submissions Platform - production architecture (us-east-1, two Availability Zones)
Blue = Walkthrough 1 (open exam, autosave every 30 s, submit, auto-mark). Orange = Walkthrough 2 (40 MB upload, tutor notified). Grey dashed = supporting.
Data subnets have no route to the Internet. Each AZ's app route table uses its own NAT gateway.
lifecycle: IA 30 d → Glacier IR 180 d → Deep Archive 365 d → delete 5 y
